candidate_query:
MATCH (sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(owner:Spec)
WHERE owner.specNumber = specNumber
RETURN specNumber, count(DISTINCT s.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY sectionCount DESC, specNumber ASC
